Changing posts later

  • Caption, hashtags, alt text: editable any time from the post's menu, with no effect on the grid.
  • The image: Instagram does not let you swap the picture of a published post. To change a tile you delete or archive it and post the new version, which lands at the top of the grid. Instagram's grid reorder lets you drag it back into place, so check your account has it before you repost.
  • Hiding a post: Archive removes it from the grid and keeps the likes and comments; Unarchive puts it back in its original spot.
  • New designs: every tile is an editable HTML file in ~/safer-instagram/, so a changed headline or colour is a re-render, not a redesign.
